fact: A research agenda on digital and governance issues in West Africa was co-built at the Foire aux Savoirs in Cotonou on 21-22 May 2025, co-organised with ACED and ASIN, with think-tank researchers and national digital agencies setting priorities.
title: Agenda de recherche sur les enjeux croisés du numérique et de la gouvernance en Afrique de l'Ouest
